contracts.declared_mechanism: The @input_guardrail-decorated async guardrail_function, which executes guardrail_agent ('Floorplan Checker Agent') over the run input and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput(output_info=reason, tripwire_triggered=is_not_allowed); registered on my_agent via input_guardrails=[guardrail_function]. A triggered tripwire raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered, which run_agent catches in the except clause around Runner.run and converts to an error response ({'error': 'Only valid floorplan-images are allowed...'}), abandoning the run result and its image outputs.

contracts.protected_operation: The Interior Design Agent run — Runner.run(my_agent, formatted_input) over the user-submitted floorplan image (base64 input_image) and design-style text (input_text) — which plans per-room designs and generates room images via the agent's ImageGenerationTool.
contracts.protected_resource: The Interior Design Agent run and its ImageGenerationTool image-generation effect (room design images derived from the user-submitted floorplan and design preferences).
contracts.protection_obligation: User-submitted floorplan images and design-style preferences submitted to the Interior Design Agent run must pass the registered input guardrail (input must be a valid floorplan, the design preferences must be relevant to interior design, and the request must not be offensive or not safe for work) before the run proceeds, so that disallowed input triggers the guardrail tripwire, aborts the run at Runner.run, and prevents the run's ImageGenerationTool external image-generation effect from being committed.
